name: Doodle Climb
tagline: Keep bouncing. Climb higher than your friends.
description: Steer an automatic jumper through the same seeded platform route. Wrap around the edges, catch spring platforms and climb as high as you can in three quick rounds.
howToPlay: Hold left or right to steer. Your jumper bounces automatically.
Land while falling. Spring platforms boost you higher; the sides wrap around.
Fall below your screen and you're out. Each round's best height adds to your score.
